quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Near-monopoly US P&C insurance regulatory data and claims analytics toll booth (ISO, Xactimate). Operating ROIC normalized to the 35.0% cap under the v6.23 Negative Tangible Capital Standard (tangible equity is negative post-divestiture of Wood Mackenzie, with tangible ROIC >100% and reported operating ROIC of 43.87%). FY2024 peak Owner EPS of $6.776 accepted without adjustment as representative of normalized pure-play earning power. Forward 5-10Y Owner EPS compounding calibrated at 9.0% (4.0% organic volume/upsell + 3.0% annual pricing power + 0.5% margin expansion + 1.5% net share repurchases). Gross debt of $4.77B was temporarily elevated at FY25 year-end by escrowed senior notes for the AccuLynx transaction, which were fully redeemed upon deal termination in January 2026, leaving normalized net debt at $2.60B (2.86x net debt/NI), with robust 7.86x EBIT interest coverage and 109.9% multi-year FCF conversion.
